## 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30
- [ ] Payload compression for station uploads (plan 12 scope note, deferred):
      wanted before the winter deployment to cut the cellular data bill, but
      it needs its own gateway-side tests. See
      specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md; touches
      station/upload.py. Size: plan. Done when: uploads are compressed, the
      gateway accepts them, and the gateway-side tests pass.
- [ ] Fallback buffer stays at 64 MB (plan 12 Task 2, left as is): the plan
      enlarges it only if a station reports `BUFFER_FULL`; none has in the
      last year of logs. See specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md;
      touches the SD-card fallback buffer used by station/upload.py.
      Size: quick-fix. Revisit if: a station health log reports `BUFFER_FULL`.
</edit>

**5. Retire the plan and spec.** Neither file has relative links, so nothing needs re-pointing.

<command>
mkdir -p specs/plans/completed specs/completed && git mv specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md && git mv specs/station-upload-retry.md specs/completed/station-upload-retry.md && git commit -m "chore(specs): retire plan 12"
</command>

**Message to my partner:**

Plan 12 is retired, with two corrections to what I reported earlier.

- **Wrong status header.** I wrote "nothing deferred" at step 2, but your scan found two real deferrals. I corrected the header to point at `specs/deferred_items.md`.
- **Payload compression** (plan line 13) is filed as a work item: Size `plan`, Done when "uploads are compressed, the gateway accepts them, and the gateway-side tests pass". You want it before winter, so it is work and will age. It is not a watch item.
- **64 MB fallback buffer** (plan line 36) is filed as a watch item: Size `quick-fix`, Revisit if "a station health log reports `BUFFER_FULL`". If you would rather record it as a decision that needs no item, tell me. I would then write `→ dropped:` on your word.
- **Backlog count.** It is now 9 open, not the 7 I reported at step 4. Both new items are dated today, and the buffer item is a watch item, so neither adds to the aged tail.
- **Retire.** The plan moves to `specs/plans/completed/` and the spec to `specs/completed/` in one `chore(specs): retire plan 12` commit. The spec is retired because no other live plan implements it.
- **Roadmap handoff.** The plan has no `Roadmap:` header line, so step 3a does not apply.
- **No git repo here.** This environment reports no git repository, even though the session says the branch is `feat/upload-retry`. If `git mv` fails, I will fall back to plain `mv` and tell you that nothing could be committed.

Next is finishing-a-development-branch.
